provenance.exposure: These recordings were read for camera-LiDAR v2. No INS-LiDAR method is run by this metadata inventory.
provenance.independent_rig_policy: All KITTI dates count as one platform, separate from Boreas.

selection_rule: From the eighteen other-day KITTI raw archives inventoried for camera-LiDAR v2, select the first three chronological recording IDs with at least 600 archived Velodyne frames and 600 Velodyne/OXTS members in their first-600-index download metadata. Exclude spent INS-LiDAR development recordings. Inspect only live HEAD and ZIP central-directory metadata; retain all three even if a pin/budget fails.
